title: Sorceress on Floating Isle
description: A hooded female sorceress with long white hair stands on a dark floating stone platform, holding a glowing blue orb staff in one hand while casting a swirling vortex of blue magic and lightning from the other. The dramatic night scene features ancient stone pillars, glowing golden runes, a wrecked ship in stormy waters below, and a large solar eclipse dominating the purple sky with falling rain.
prompt: A powerful sorceress with flowing white hair and dark robes stands on a jagged floating stone platform, holding a tall staff topped with a glowing blue orb. She casts a massive swirling vortex of blue energy and lightning that pulls in ancient books and artifacts. Dramatic night scene with heavy rain, ancient stone pillars covered in flowers, glowing golden runes on the ground, a wrecked ship in turbulent waters below, and a large dark solar eclipse glowing in the purple stormy sky.
